rationale: Price is at 88.5% of today's range after a massive gap-up and run from $87 to $100, sitting just $0.70 below the session high with the last five 1-minute candles showing a mild pullback and consolidation — no clear directional edge. Entering long near the top of an extended move risks a mean-reversion flush, while shorting into strong momentum with elevated relative volume (3.74x) and price above VWAP and 9-EMA carries equal risk. The spread is manageable but the risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the current position in range and lack of a defined technical trigger.
